annotations.title: An app's growth brief and campaigns

description: Use this when the user asks what to do next for growth, how a campaign is going, or what a move brought. One app's growth brief (audiences, promise, objective, hours, the channels the founder does, whether it is confirmed, and the constraint read from its numbers, with the numbers) and each campaign: its audience, need, link token, and its moves (a page, a list, a link, a thread reply, a creator, a custom product page), each with its state (prepared, done, live as read back, dropped), what was prepared for it (the pitch or reply to send), where it can be seen, what the live read found, and its outcome (measuring, not enough data, blocked, better, can't tell, done) with why and the numbers it came from. Moves and states are the same as the web app's Campaigns page.
name: campaigns
